item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 7 September 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 7 September 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) 📍 The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Gornyak, Dobropolye, Novovodyanoye, Novogrishino (Donetsk People's Republic), Ivanovka, Novoandreyevka, and Novotroitskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 360 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station. ↗️ The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence. 📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and four national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Gornyak, Dobropolye, Novovodyanoye, Novogrishino (Donetsk People's Republic), Ivanovka, Novoandreyevka, and Novotroitskoye (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 360 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade, one airborne brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Barvinovka, Vasinovka, Nikolskoye, Obshcheye, Omelnik, and Chervony Yar (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 275 troops and ten motor vehicles.
💥
Units of the Dnepr Group of Forces inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Antonovka, Kushugum, and Razumovka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 30 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, and 21 motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage on
the Ukranian transport and logistics infrastructure, used by the AFU, storage areas of UAVs and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
two guided aerial bombs and 498 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy
has lost:
▫️
674
aircraft,

284
helicopters,
▫️
229,391
unmanned aerial vehicles,
▫️
672
anti-aircraft missile systems,
▫️
30,850
tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,776
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,394
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
71,267
special military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⚡️ In Kharkov region, the Sever Group's units continue to collapse the perimeter of the encirclement and destroy enemy formations
item.description: ⚡️ In Kharkov region, the Sever Group's units continue to collapse the perimeter of the encirclement and destroy enemy formations close to Varvarovka, Malaya Volchya, Nefedovka, and Chernoye (Kharkov region). 📊 At the moment, about 1,700 militants are encircled. During the day, the enemy losses amounted to up to 40 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two pick-up trucks, and three quadricycles. The enemy did not perform attempts to break out of the encirclement. 💥 In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Malaya Rybitsa, Ulanovo, and Hoten (Sumy region). ▪️ In total, the enemy lost up to 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, ten motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces. ↗️ The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions. Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade close to Boldyrevka, Kovalevka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Mayaki, Raygorodok, and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The enemy losses amounted to more than 170 Ukrainian troops, one U.K.-made Snatch armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns. 📍 The Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the tactical situation along the front line. the Sever Group's units continue to collapse the perimeter of the encirclement and destroy enemy formations
close to Varvarovka, Malaya Volchya, Nefedovka, and Chernoye (Kharkov region).
📊
At the moment, about 1,700 militants are encircled.
During the day, the enemy losses amounted to up to 40 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, two pick-up trucks, and three quadricycles. The enemy did not perform attempts to break out of the encirclement.
💥
In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Malaya Rybitsa, Ulanovo, and Hoten (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost up to 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, ten motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
↗️
The Zapad Group's units took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian elements inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade close to Boldyrevka, Kovalevka, Chervony Oskol (Kharkov region), Mayaki, Raygorodok, and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 170 Ukrainian troops, one U.K.-made Snatch armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group's units improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of two mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, and one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Vysokoivanovka, Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Krasny Molochar, Nikolayevka, Novoselovka, Semenovka, and Slavyansk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 200 troops, one U.K.-made Husky TSV armoured fighting vehicle, 23 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.

item.title: ▫️ Spotted and nullified: AFU drone base eliminated by precision strike During aerial reconnaissance, Russian servicemen
item.description: Spotted and nullified: AFU drone base eliminated by precision strike ▫️ During aerial reconnaissance, Russian servicemen detected a command post of the AFU's heavy drones in the basement of one of the multi-storey building in Druzhkovka. The enemy attempted to hide behind the residential building's concrete walls. 🔥 The shelter didn't save the militants. After precision strikes of Russian drones, the under ground UAV command post was completely destroyed along with the crew and all the equipment. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes against the port infrastructure and maritime vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukra
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to launch strikes against the port infrastructure and maritime vessels operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 In the evening 6 September, attack UAVs hit Mavka dry cargo ship with military hardware in the port of Chernomorsk. 🔥 This morning, strike drones hit : 📍 in the port of Ismail, a production and loading system that was used to unload vessels with military cargo supplied to the AFU by Western countries; 📍 in the Black Sea waters, a patrol vessel used to escort cargo ships with military equipment. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
